**Seri Jaya Store Sdn. Bhd. – Supplier Vetting Snapshot** | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Company** | Seri Jaya Store Sdn. Bhd. (Private Ltd.) | | **Reg. No.** | SYN‑000510 | | **Founded** | 30 Nov 2006 | | **Location / Industry** | Retail – mobile phones & accessories, Kuala Lumpur (operations in Kuantan) | | **Share Capital** | RM 100,000 | | **Directors (4)** | Managing Director, Executive Director, Director, Independent Director (most recent appointment Aug 2025) | | **Ownership** | 96.87 % held by Director 2 (individual), 3.13 % by Director 1 | | **Audit** | Audit Firm 5 – unqualified opinions for FY 2022‑2024 | | **Financial Trend (RM)** | **Revenue:** 6.60 M (2022) → 5.52 M (2023) → 4.37 M (2024) – declining 12‑19 % YoY
**Net Profit:** 229 k (2022) → 113 k (2023) → 36 k (2024) – profit margin fell from 3.5 % to 0.8 % | | **Liquidity** | Quick ratio strong (2.8‑4.4); cash‑to‑revenue ~12‑14 %; cash balance sufficient to cover short‑term liabilities | | **Cash Flow** | Operating cash flow positive but falling (RM 598 k → 166 k); free cash flow turned negative in 2024 (‑RM 50 k) | | **Leverage** | Debt/Equity decreasing (0.33 → 0.14); interest coverage still adequate (>2×) but slipping (8.2 → 2.7) | | **Operational Efficiency** | Cash conversion cycle ~112‑120 days; DSO rising then falling; inventory turnover 4.6‑5.5× | | **Key Risks** | • Consistent revenue and profit decline over three years
• Shrinking margins and weakening EBITDA
• Growing reliance on cash flow to fund operations (negative free cash flow 2024)
• Concentrated ownership – decisions tied to a single individual | | **Overall Assessment** | The company is financially viable (positive equity, good liquidity) but shows a clear downward trend in sales and profitability. It may be suitable for low‑value, short‑term contracts, but the declining performance and thin profit margins pose a moderate risk for larger or strategic engagements. Consider requiring stronger guarantees or limiting exposure until the turnaround is evident.
